missingInformation.description: The referral says parent input will be requested and the evaluation plan lists parent input as information to be gathered. The psychoeducational sources of information and the eligibility evidence reviewed do not list parent input, and no supplied document records it. A parent input form or a record of parent input in the evaluation would answer this.
